header.name: Digital Technologies and Social Entrepreneurship
header.description: The digital revolution has been transformative in its impact. Digital technology has not just impacted our workspaces, but also, has changed us at a much deeper level. We now socialize differently, learn differently, perhaps even think differently from how we did at the turn of the century. This course will explore how digital technology affects our lives and how this knowledge can help us plan more impactful social entrepreneurships and social change programs. We will especially focus on high social impact sectors such as Education, Health and Environment. We will deepen our understanding on how social and technological revolution go hand in hand. The two main concepts of the course are social change and technological change by digital means. We will offer the students the opportunity to critically analyze how digital spaces are integrated in people’s life and their decisions, feelings, motivation, and behaviors. Further we will offer our students opportunities to get real life exposure to problems in the selected domains so that the experiences deepen their knowledge, expand their perspectives. Using their firsthand observations, students will present insights and innovative entrepreneurship/intrapreneurship ideas for digital usages.
